findings.title: Nested field many parameter does not correctly override schema instance many=False
findings.explanation: The code checks `if self.many:` which is true if `self.many` is `True` or `False` (because `many` is a boolean). However, if `self.many` is `False`, it should still set `self._schema.many = False`. The current code only sets it if `self.many` is `True`, leaving the original `many` value of the schema instance unchanged when `self.many` is `False`. This causes the test `test_nested_many_should_override_schema_many_case2` to fail because it expects `many=False` to override the schema's `many=True`.
